chapters.text_fil: Ang Ilog Agusan na dumadaan sa Agusan del Norte ay isa sa pinakamahalagang ilog ng Mindanao. Para sa mga Manobo at Higaonon, ang ilog na ito ay buhay na nilalang na may sariling kalooban. Ayon sa kanilang alamat, ang Ilog Agusan ay ipinanganak mula sa isang makapangyarihang babaeng diyos na nagbago ng kanyang sarili upang maging tubig at bigyan ng buhay ang tuyong lupa.
chapters.text_eng: The Agusan River that flows through Agusan del Norte is one of the most important rivers in Mindanao. For the Manobo and Higaonon, this river is a living being with its own will. According to their legend, the Agusan River was born from a powerful goddess who transformed herself into water to give life to the dry land.
